implementation.support: metric edge intervals with lateral bounds and explicit unknown mass
implementation.propagation: bounded reachable support on versioned graph using shortest path length
implementation.branch_measure: uniform arc-length measure over reachable known support
implementation.frontier_model: explicit unknown branch prior; default probability 0.5, uncalibrated
implementation.negative_observation: fresh independent group Bayes update with coverage-averaged detection probability
implementation.reacquisition: position likelihood over graph-edge support with explicit unknown likelihood

equations.known_initial_speed_and_acceleration: v0*t + 0.5*a*t^2 until v_max, then continue at v_max
equations.negative_update: b_j+ proportional to (1-P_D(j))*b_j-; unknown mass uses L_u

negative_cases: far endpoint unavailable before bounded travel time
junction branching begins only when reachable
frontier creates unknown-route mass only after it is reachable
blocked edge is not used as a known route
occluded, blind, invalid or uncovered regions retain probability
partial coverage applies only its average covered detection probability
stale, duplicate, out-of-order and wrong-version observations are rejected
zero Bayes normalizer broadens to unknown instead of dividing by zero
reacquisition preserves normalized mass and a nonzero unknown component
invalid intervals, covariance, timestamps and probability mass are rejected

limitations: No real graph, visibility/detection probability calibration or opponent turn prior is available.
Uniform arc-length propagation is an explicitly named uninformative measure, not measured behavior.
The default frontier branch probability is an engineering prior and must be calibrated or versioned before deployment.
Continuous reachable support is propagated conservatively; this is not a nonholonomic dynamics certificate.
Synthetic SIL does not establish physical reachability or G3 acceptance.
handoff: P4.5 codec must serialize topology/map/localization versions, timestamps, unknown_mass and fidelity.
Runtime must reject beliefs bound to stale graph or localization versions.
Detection probabilities and frontier prior require profile-specific calibration before G3.
